appearance_facts.fact: A single light-blue dot sits at the origin area, with no visible week label attached to it.
A light-blue dot labeled 'Week 2' is positioned near the 20 mark on the x-axis and just above the 60 mark on the y-axis.
A light-blue dot labeled 'Week 3' is positioned near the 32 mark on the x-axis and near the 90 mark on the y-axis.
A light-blue dot labeled 'Week 4' is positioned near the 42 mark on the x-axis and at the 120 mark on the y-axis.
A light-blue dot labeled 'Week 5' is positioned near the 52 mark on the x-axis and near the 150 mark on the y-axis.
A light-blue dot labeled 'Week 6' is positioned near the 62 mark on the x-axis and near the 190 mark on the y-axis.
The six labeled points form a tight, upward-sloping linear trend from lower-left to upper-right.
